duration.text: The Pharmaceutical Science at University of Jinan is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3444 USD/per year ￥ 24800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. application form 2. personal resume 3. scanned copy of passport 4. Senior high school graduation certificate 5. Senior high school academic transcript 6. For the students interested in Bachelor of Science, results in new HSK examinations should be above level 3 (level 3 included). Certificates are required.

requirements.text: Undergraduate Program Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.Senior high school graduation. For the students interested in Bachelors of Arts, results in HSK examinations should be above level six (level six included). For the students interested in Bachelor of Science, results in HSK examinations should be above level 3 (level 3 included).
